assumptions.statement: Repository provisional boundaries are used only for concept generation, package consistency, offline display and recalculation.
assumptions.impact: Machine intake and content review can proceed, but formal professional scoring still awaits official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons; maintainers determine the exact review impact.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, surveyed buildings, municipal capacity, heritage protection and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, floor area, demolition and capital cost remain unknown; proposed footprints and projects are concept-only.

assumptions.statement: Three host yards and twelve hosted rooms are typological design proposals inside provisional key areas, not confirmed sites or public-access rights.
assumptions.impact: Operators, access hours, fire safety, accessibility and property rights must be verified before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: No university, enterprise, community, public agency or service organization is represented as a committed operator or partner.
assumptions.impact: The Host Protocol is an operating brief for future negotiation, not a staffing or funding commitment.

assumptions.statement: Housing, healthcare, education, immigration, legal and public-resource interfaces are referral concepts only.
assumptions.impact: They cannot promise eligibility, allocation, outcomes or government decisions.

assumptions.statement: AI may assist translation, routing, capacity forecasts and anonymous service-quality review but must not rank people, make final access decisions or replace professional judgment.
assumptions.impact: Every scenario requires a visible human fallback, appeal route, shutdown condition and data-minimization rule.

assumptions.statement: The exact heritage inventory, structural condition and protection-control geography are not published in the package.
assumptions.impact: Adaptive-reuse diagrams are typological; retain/renovate/demolish decisions await qualified survey and approval.
